1879060377.name: Muster Courage
1879060377.desc: Removes Poison, Disease, Wound or Fear effects from nearby allies.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879094937.name: Dissonance - Stance
1879094937.desc:
Your charismatic speech drives fear into the hearts of your enemies.

<rgb=#FF7700>You lose access to all fellowship heals and all normal heals become Self-only.

Echoes of Battle becomes Timeless Echoes of Battle.

Major Ballad becomes an offensive Ballad.

Coda of Vigour becomes Coda of Fury.</rgb> 

Only one Stance may be active at a time.

1879097881.name: Gut Punch
1879097881.desc: When your target begins preparing an attack, you give them a swift punch to the gut to interrupt their preparation.

1879112985.name: Barbed Arrows
1879112985.desc: Your Archer can use Barbed arrows to cause bleeding wounds that slow the target's movement.

1879115161.name: Power of the Void
1879115161.desc: Summons a fell icon of darkness.

1879134361.name: Spear and Shield
1879134361.desc: Mastery over the Spear: Allows the Warden to perform Spear Gambits quickly.

1879139737.name: Lethal Kiss
1879139737.desc: You fling a tightly compacted ball of webbing coated in acid, damaging your target

1879153049.name: Epic Conclusion
1879153049.desc: An enormously powerful lightning attack dealing +Damage per attunement consumed.\n \n Requires Battle Attunement.

1879209881.name: Steed of the Guardian
1879209881.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the guardian.

1879231257.name: Shield and Fist
1879231257.desc: Mastery over the Shield: Allows Warden to perform Shield Gambits quickly.

1879232409.name: Ranged Exultation of Battle
1879232409.desc: Wardens find strength in the sure knowledge that they are fighting to defend the defenceless.\nDrains significant morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879239577.name: Seeking Arrow
1879239577.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879252889.name: War-steed: Light
1879252889.desc: The Courser is a lightly armoured War-steed. Fast and agile, the Courser provides the greatest speed and maneuverability on the battlefield, trading Endurance and Armour to retain their nimbleness.

1879260313.name: Bond of the Lore-master
1879260313.desc: The bond of the Lore-master is strong. With it, allies may benefit from an increased knowledge of beasts and the natural world alike.

1879260441.name: Tale of Eorl
1879260441.desc: The Minstrel tells the tale of Eorl and the Eotheod who rode to the aid of Gondor at the Battle of the Field of Celebrant. The tale inspires those who hear it, and increases their ability to help or receive help from their allies.

1879270553.name: Pinning Shot of Light
1879270553.desc: A short range attack that will briefly root the target.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879291417.name: Never Surrender
1879291417.desc: Wardens are difficult to defeat and the most learned will not surrender even when they face the most vile of odds.

1879339417.name: Ithilien Fox
1879339417.desc: Summons a friendly fox from Ithilien.

1879351577.name: Hopeful Swan Kite
1879351577.desc: Brings out a hopeful swan kite for you to fly.

1879360793.name: Blight Frog
1879360793.desc: Brings out a blight frog to keep you company.

1879366937.name: Elk of Felegoth's Glory
1879366937.desc: A mighty Lasgalen elk, garbed in celebration of Felegoth.

1879414297.name: Yule Gala Steed
1879414297.desc: A steed dressed in the finest Yule raiment.

1879426073.name: Efficient Strikes
1879426073.desc: For a brief time, abilities consume less Mettle.

1879466265.name: Riposte
1879466265.desc:
Shift back into an aggressive posture with a cutting strike.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Advance deals more damage.
</rgb><rgb=#ecdd11> Advance gains a chance to stun.</rgb>
<rgb=#33BCFF> Marked Foes deals more damage.</rgb>

1879475993.name: Guide to Jax Phanâl
1879475993.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Jax Phanâl on the Cape of Umbar.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879485337.name: Merrymaking Hamster
1879485337.desc: Summons a brave hamster to join in the fun and raise your spirits.

1879488025.name: Friend of the Wilds (Juvenile Swamp-guardian)
1879488025.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879508633.name: Death-light Scorpion
1879508633.desc: Summons a death-light scorpion to accompany you on your travels.

1879508761.name: Muster at Sul Madásh
1879508761.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Sul Madásh in Adagím in Mûr Ghala.
